test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the portal launched by the Government in 2022 that aims to ease the loan application and disbursement process by the applicant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jan Samarth.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jan Samarth** is a digital platform launched by the **Government of India** to simplify the **loan application** and** disbursement process** for **small businesses and entrepreneurs.**
 
• The platform is designed to offer a **hassle-free experience** to borrowers by providing end-to-end loan services, including** loan application, verification, and disbursal.**
 
• The portal will also provide customized loan options based on the **borrower's credit history, repayment capacity,** and other relevant parameters.
 
• The platform will also offer various other financial services like **insurance, investment, and pension** schemes for the benefit of small businesses and entrepreneurs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swayatta** is a digital platform launched by the** Government of India** to promote **self-employment and entrepreneurship** among the youth.

 
 
• It offers various services like **skill development, mentorship, and financial assistance** to aspiring entrepreneurs.
 
 
 
• **E-Shram** is a digital platform launched by the Government of India to provide **social security** benefits to the **unorganized sector** workers.
 
 
• It offers services like **registration, enrollment**, and tracking of** social security** schemes like** insurance, pension, and healthcare.**
 
 
 
• **Yukti** is a digital platform launched by the Government of India to promote **research and innovation** in the field of science and technology.
 
 
• It offers various services like **funding, collaboration, and networking **opportunities to **researchers, scientists, and entrepreneurs.**
